mapper.select: SELECT WO.ORDERID, WO.ORDERNAME, WO.TOTALQTY, WO.STARTQTY, SUM(PG.LOTQTY) LOTTOTALQTY FROM PACKGIFT PG INNER JOIN PACKCARTON PC ON PG.GIFTCODE = PC.GIFTCODE INNER JOIN WIP_STORAGE WS ON PC.CARTONCODE = WS.CARTONCODE INNER JOIN WORKORDER WO ON WO.ORDERID = #{orderid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE PG.LOTID IN (SELECT PL.LOTID FROM PRP_LOT PL WHERE PL.WORKORDERID = #{orderid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) AND PG.DELETEFLAG='N' AND PC.DELETEFLAG='N' AND (WS.STATUS = 'N' OR WS.STATUS = 'Y' ) GROUP BY WO.ORDERNAME, WO.ORDERID, WO.TOTALQTY, WO.STARTQTY

SELECT WO.ORDERID FROM PACKGIFT PG INNER JOIN PACKCARTON PC ON PG.GIFTCODE = PC.GIFTCODE INNER JOIN PRP_LOT PL ON PG.LOTID = PL.LOTID INNER JOIN WORKORDER WO ON PL.WORKORDERID = WO.ORDERID WHERE UPPER(WO.STATE) != 'FINISH' AND PC.CARTONCODE = #{cartoncode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY WO.ORDERNAME, WO.ORDERID, WO.TOTALQTY, WO.STARTQTY

SELECT COUNT(1) RESULTNUM FROM RMM_LOTMATERIALLIST RL, UPN U, PARTNUMBER PA, RMM_UPNPRINT RM WHERE U.PNID = PA.PNID AND RL.PN = PA.PN AND RM.PNID = PA.PNID AND RL.LOTNAME = #{lotname,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND U.UPNNAME = #{upnname,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND (INSTR(#{reelname,jdbcType=VARCHAR},RM.OBJ2)>0 OR (RM.MATERIALATTR like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{reelname,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%'))) AND LENGTH(obj2)>4 AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MO.MOID, MO.MONAME, MO.LINEID, MO.LOTID, MO.STATUS, MO.ISUSING, MO.BOARDSIDE, MO.LEADFREE, MO.LLID, MO.DESCRIPTION, MO.USERNAME, MO.DATETIME, LO.EQPNAME, AR.AREANAME FROM MATERIALORDER MO LEFT JOIN PRP_LOT PL ON MO.LOTID = PL.LOTID LEFT JOIN LOADMATERIAL LO ON MO.MOID=LO.MOID LEFT JOIN AREA AR ON AR.AREAID=MO.LINEID WHERE UPPER(MO.STATUS) !='CLOSE' AND UPPER(MO.STATUS) NOT LIKE '%HOLD%' AND UPPER(MO.STATUS) NOT LIKE '%LOADPARTS%' AND UPPER(PL.STATUS) NOT LIKE '%HOLD%' AND EQPNAME= #{eqpname,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY TO_DATE(DATETIME, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') DESC)

SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MO.MOID, MO.MONAME, MO.LINEID, MO.LOTID, MO.STATUS, MO.ISUSING, MO.BOARDSIDE, MO.LEADFREE, MO.LLID, MO.DESCRIPTION, MO.USERNAME, MO.DATETIME, LO.EQPNAME, AR.AREANAME FROM MATERIALORDER MO LEFT JOIN PRP_LOT PL ON MO.LOTID = PL.LOTID LEFT JOIN LOADMATERIAL LO ON MO.MOID=LO.MOID LEFT JOIN AREA AR ON AR.AREAID=MO.LINEID WHERE UPPER(MO.STATUS) LIKE 'LOADPARTS%' AND EQPNAME= #{eqpname,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY TO_DATE(DATETIME, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') )

SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MO.MOID, MO.MONAME, MO.LINEID, MO.LOTID, MO.STATUS, MO.ISUSING, MO.BOARDSIDE, MO.LEADFREE, MO.LLID, MO.DESCRIPTION, MO.USERNAME, MO.DATETIME, LO.EQPNAME, AR.AREANAME FROM MATERIALORDER MO LEFT JOIN PRP_LOT PL ON MO.LOTID = PL.LOTID LEFT JOIN LOADMATERIAL LO ON MO.MOID=LO.MOID LEFT JOIN AREA AR ON AR.AREAID=MO.LINEID WHERE UPPER(MO.STATUS) LIKE '%LOADPARTS%'
AND EQPNAME= #{eqpname,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY TO_DATE(DATETIME, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') DESC)

SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MO.MOID, MO.MONAME, MO.LINEID, MO.LOTID, MO.STATUS, MO.ISUSING, MO.BOARDSIDE, MO.LEADFREE, MO.LLID, MO.DESCRIPTION, MO.USERNAME, MO.DATETIME, LO.EQPNAME, AR.AREANAME FROM MATERIALORDER MO LEFT JOIN PRP_LOT PL ON MO.LOTID = PL.LOTID LEFT JOIN LOADMATERIAL LO ON MO.MOID=LO.MOID LEFT JOIN AREA AR ON AR.AREAID=MO.LINEID WHERE (UPPER(MO.STATUS) !='CLOSE' OR UPPER(MO.STATUS) LIKE '%HOLD%') AND UPPER(PL.STATUS) NOT LIKE '%HOLD%'
AND EQPNAME= #{eqpname,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY TO_DATE(DATETIME, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') DESC)

SELECT FEEDERID, FEEDERNAME, DESCRIPTION, FEEDERTYPE, EQPTYPEID, NEEDPM, MAXQTY, USEDQTY, MOID, EQPID, STAGE, SLOT, USERNAME, DATETIME, WARNINGQTY FROM FEEDER WHERE FEEDERNAME=#{feedername,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT DISTINCT * FROM (SELECT RP.* FROM RMM_PICKLIST RP,UPN U,PARTNUMBER P WHERE RP.Picktype = 'EDGEINVENTORY' AND RP.Status = 'RELEASE' AND RP.TRANSFERID = #{workorderid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND RP.UPN=U.UPNNAME AND U.PNID=P.PNID AND PN = #{pn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND U.REMAININGQTY>0 UNION ALL SELECT RP.* FROM RMM_PICKLIST RP,PACKCARTON PC,PACKGIFT PG WHERE RP.Picktype = 'EDGEINVENTORY' AND RP.Status = 'RELEASE' AND RP.TRANSFERID = #{workorderid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND RP.UPN=PC.CARTONCODE AND PC.DELETEFLAG='N' AND PC.GIFTCODE=PG.GIFTCODE AND PG.GIFTQTY>0 AND PC.PRODUCTPN = #{pn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UNION ALL SELECT RP.* FROM RMM_PICKLIST RP,UPN U,PARTNUMBER P WHERE RP.Picktype = 'EDGEINVENTORY' AND RP.Status = 'RELEASE' AND RP.TRANSFERID =#{lotid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND RP.UPN=U.UPNNAME AND U.PNID=P.PNID AND PN = #{pn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND U.REMAININGQTY>0 UNION ALL SELECT RP.* FROM RMM_PICKLIST RP,PACKCARTON PC,PACKGIFT PG WHERE RP.Picktype = 'EDGEINVENTORY' AND RP.Status = 'RELEASE' AND RP.TRANSFERID =#{lotid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND RP.UPN=PC.CARTONCODE AND PC.DELETEFLAG='N' AND PC.GIFTCODE=PG.GIFTCODE AND PG.GIFTQTY>0 AND PC.PRODUCTPN =#{pn,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

SELECT A.* FROM LOADINGLISTCONTENT A, (SELECT * FROM (SELECT C.* FROM LOADINGLIST C WHERE C.PRODUCTNAME = #{productname,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND C.LINENAME = #{linename,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY VERSION DESC) WHERE ROWNUM = 1) B WHERE A.llid = B.LLID

SELECT DISTINCT LM.MOID moid, LM.EQPNAME EQPNAME, LM.MFUNAME MFUNAME, LM.SLOT slot, LM.STAGE STAGE, LM.PN PN, LM.QTY QTY, CASE WHEN LM.TASKNAME IS NULL AND MO.STATUS NOT IN ('FINISH','CLOSE') THEN '未上料' WHEN LM.TASKNAME = 'LoadFeeders' THEN '上料未对料' WHEN LM.TASKNAME = 'ReplenishFeeders' THEN '续料未对料' WHEN LM.TASKNAME = 'ComfirmParts' THEN '已对料' WHEN LM.TASKNAME IS NULL THEN '已卸料' else ' '
END status, NVL(LM.TASKNAME, ' ') TASKNAME, U.UPNNAME upn, U.REMAININGQTY REMAININGQTY, decode(F.FEEDERNAME,null,'',substr(F.FEEDERNAME,-3)) AS feeder, CASE WHEN LM.TASKNAME IS NULL AND MO.STATUS NOT IN ('FINISH','CLOSE') THEN 1 WHEN LM.TASKNAME = 'LoadFeeders' THEN 2 WHEN LM.TASKNAME = 'ReplenishFeeders' THEN 2 WHEN LM.TASKNAME = 'ComfirmParts' THEN 3 WHEN LM.TASKNAME IS NULL THEN 4 else 4 END AS COLOR, nvl(U.TOTALQTY,-1) AS TOTALQTY, LM.QTY * PR.TOTALQTY ALLQTY FROM LOADMATERIAL LM
INNER JOIN MATERIALORDER MO ON MO.MOID=LM.MOID INNER JOIN PRP_LOT PR ON MO.LOTID=PR.LOTID
LEFT JOIN FEEDER F2 ON F2.FEEDERNAME=LM.FEEDER LEFT JOIN UPN U ON U.MOID=LM.MOID AND U.SLOT=LM.SLOT AND U.EQPNAME=LM.EQPNAME AND U.FEEDERID=F2.FEEDERID LEFT JOIN FEEDER F ON U.FEEDERID = F.FEEDERID WHERE LM.MOID = #{moid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND LM.EQPNAME = #{eqpname,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY LM.MOID, LM.EQPNAME, LM.SLOT

select * from ( SELECT DISTINCT LM.MOID moid, LM.EQPNAME EQPNAME, LM.MFUNAME MFUNAME, LM.SLOT slot, LM.STAGE STAGE, LM.PN PN, LM.QTY QTY, CASE WHEN LM.TASKNAME IS NULL AND MO.STATUS NOT IN ('FINISH','CLOSE') THEN '未上料' WHEN LM.TASKNAME = 'LoadFeeders' THEN '上料未对料' WHEN LM.TASKNAME = 'ReplenishFeeders' THEN '续料未对料' WHEN LM.TASKNAME = 'ComfirmParts' THEN '已对料' WHEN LM.TASKNAME IS NULL THEN '已卸料' else ''
END status, NVL(LM.TASKNAME, ' ') TASKNAME, U.UPNNAME upn, U.REMAININGQTY REMAININGQTY, decode(F.FEEDERNAME,null,'',substr(F.FEEDERNAME,-3)) AS feeder, CASE WHEN LM.TASKNAME IS NULL AND MO.STATUS NOT IN ('FINISH','CLOSE') THEN 1 WHEN LM.TASKNAME = 'LoadFeeders' THEN 2 WHEN LM.TASKNAME = 'ReplenishFeeders' THEN 2 WHEN LM.TASKNAME = 'ComfirmParts' THEN 3 WHEN LM.TASKNAME IS NULL THEN 4 else 4 END AS COLOR, nvl(U.TOTALQTY,-1) AS TOTALQTY, LM.QTY * PR.TOTALQTY ALLQTY FROM LOADMATERIAL LM
INNER JOIN MATERIALORDER MO ON MO.MOID=LM.MOID INNER JOIN PRP_LOT PR ON MO.LOTID=PR.LOTID
LEFT JOIN FEEDER F2 ON F2.FEEDERNAME=LM.FEEDER LEFT JOIN UPN U ON U.MOID=LM.MOID AND U.SLOT=LM.SLOT AND U.EQPNAME=LM.EQPNAME AND U.FEEDERID=F2.FEEDERID LEFT JOIN FEEDER F ON U.FEEDERID = F.FEEDERID WHERE LM.MOID = #{moid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND LM.EQPNAME = #{eqpname,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND LM.TASKNAME != 'ComfirmParts' ORDER BY LM.MOID, LM.EQPNAME, LM.SLOT ) where rownum < 4
SELECT * FROM A01_SMT_STENCILUSEDHISTORY WHERE MOID= #{moid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select UPNNAME,TOTALQTY,RELEASEQTY from UPN where UPNNAME = #{upnname,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND UPNNAME LIKE '0000001%'

{call A03_SHIMIN_SMT( #{P_CAOZUOTYPE,mode=IN,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{P_UPNNAME,mode=IN,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{P_MOID,mode=IN,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{P_LINEID,mode=IN,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{P_OLDUPNNAME,mode=IN,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{P_OLDMOID,mode=IN,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{P_USERID,mode=IN,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{P_ERRMSG,mode=OUT,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{P_FLAG,mode=OUT,jdbcType=INTEGER} )}

SELECT COUNT(1) contpn FROM Loadinglistcontent l WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT lc.* FROM upn u, partnumber pa, materialorder ma, Loadinglistcontent lc WHERE u.pnid = pa.pnid AND u.moid = ma.moid AND ma.moid = #{moid,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND lc.llid = ma.llid AND (pa.pn = lc.pn OR pa.pn = lc.alternatepn) AND ((lc.pn = l.pn OR lc.alternatepn = l.pn) OR (lc.pn = l.alternatepn OR lc.alternatepn = l.alternatepn))) AND llid = #{llid,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT FROMCODE CARTONCODE FROM PACK_MERGE_SPLIT WHERE TOCODE= #{cartoncode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
SELECT A.* FROM AOI_SMT_TARGET A,AREA B WHERE A.LINE= B.AREANAME AND B.AREAID= #{line,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT COUNT(PCSRESULT)- (UPNQTY-TARGET/100*UPNQTY ) QTY, line FROM (
SELECT nvl(A1.PANELCODE, A1.DBNAME || A1.PID) PID, SUBSTR(nvl(UPDATEMACHINENO, A1.MACHINEUNICODE), 0, 8) line, PRODUCTPN liaohao, A1.PCBUNICODE pcsunicode, A1.BOARDSTATUS pcsresult, A1.CHECKENDTIME, MACHINEUNICODE, UPNQTY, TARGET FROM A01_CHECKDATA_AOI A1 INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM ( SELECT MIN(mh.datetime) AS datetime, CEIL(mh.UPNQTY/lm.qty) upnqty, REPLACE(a.areaname, 'AUTOSMT-L', 'CZSMT-') areaname,AT.TARGET FROM materialhistory mh INNER JOIN materialorder mo ON mh.MOID = mo.MOID INNER JOIN area a ON mo.LINEID = a.AREAID INNER JOIN aoi_smt_target at ON a.AREANAME = at.LINE INNER JOIN upn u ON u.upnname=mh.upnname INNER JOIN partnumber pa ON pa.pnid=u.pnid INNER JOIN loadmaterial lm ON lm.moid = mo.moid AND lm.pn=pa.pn WHERE at.OBJ01 = 'ON' AND mh.UPNNAME = #{upn,jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY mh.UPNQTY, a.areaname,lm.qty,AT.TARGET ORDER BY datetime ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1) a2 ON a2.areaname = SUBSTR(nvl(A1.UPDATEMACHINENO, A1.MACHINEUNICODE), 0, 8) WHERE CHECKENDTIME BETWEEN TO_DATE(A2.DATETIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AND sysdate AND BOARDSTATUS IN ('Y', 'M', 'R', 'P') AND (nvl(UPDATEMACHINENO, A1.MACHINEUNICODE) LIKE 'CZSMT%' OR LINENAME LIKE 'CZSMT%')) GROUP BY line,UPNQTY,TARGET

SELECT U.UPNNAME,SM.CURRENTFREQUENCY,SH.USEDID,SH.LINE FROM STENCILMANAGE SM, UPN U, PARTNUMBER B, stencilhis SH WHERE SH.LINE = #{line,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND SM.UPNID = U.UPNID AND B.PN = '0000000' AND U.PNID = B.PNID AND SH.USEDID = SM.STENCILUSEDHISTID AND ROWNUM = 1

SELECT PR.PRODUCTPN AS product, PR.PANELPCS AS panelPcs, PR.WIPQTY AS wipQty, pr.lotname AS lotCode, pr.status AS status, CASE WHEN s2.stepid IS NULL OR UPPER(s2.STEPNAME) LIKE '%TRACKIN' THEN s1.description ELSE s2.description END AS lotSite FROM wip w LEFT JOIN prp_lot pr ON pr.lotname = w.sn LEFT JOIN step s1 ON s1.stepid = w.currentstepid LEFT JOIN vprocessstep vp ON vp.PROCESSID = pr.processid AND vp.STEPID = s1.stepid AND VP.PATHNAME = 'PASS' LEFT JOIN step s2 ON vp.NEXTSTEPID = s2.stepid WHERE W.SN = #{lotCode} AND ROWNUM=1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM upn WHERE upnname = #{upnName}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM prp_lot WHERE SECTION = #{section} AND lotname = #{lotName}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT id, app_id, platform, version_name, version_code, download_url, update_notes, is_forced, release_time FROM SYS_APP_VERSION WHERE app_id = #{appId} AND platform = #{platform} ORDER BY release_time DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
